caption: The drawing depicts two side views of a rounded vessel, possibly a pitcher, each with a straight base, gently curved sides, and a scalloped decorative band near the rim. Both vessel images are set within a larger rectangular frame and rendered primarily in sepia and brown ink washes on a cream-colored background. The left vessel shows a dynamic hunting scene featuring a dog chasing a deer amidst trees and foliage, with the animals in motion and naturally posed. The right vessel continues the hunting motif, with two standing male figures in period clothing—one holding a long object, the other standing further off—flanking another scene of a dog attacking a deer among bushes and grass. Both vessels exhibit similar landscape elements such as trees, plants, and ground details. At the bottom right of the page, there is a handwritten note: "Decoration on Hound handled pitcher made by Wm. E. Warner's Pottery, West Troy, N.Y."
title: Pitcher
